name: planetscale-postgres-serverless
title_zh: 在边缘运行时用 Neon 驱动连 PlanetSca
tagline_zh: Cloudflare Workers、Deno Deploy、Vercel Edge 里没有常驻 TCP。
tagline_en: Edge runtimes have no persistent TCP, so plain pg clients can't reach PlanetScale Postgres. This shows the.
desc_en: Connecting to PlanetScale Postgres from JavaScript/TypeScript using the Neon serverless driver (`@neondatabase/serverless`) — the supported way to reach PlanetScale Postgres from serverless/edge runtimes with no persistent TCP (Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Netlify, Vercel Edge). Covers the HTTP mode (`neon()`, one-shot queries, `sql.query`, `sql.transaction`) vs the WebSocket mode (`Pool`/`Cli
why_zh: 把 neon() 的 HTTP 模式与 Pool 的 WebSocket 模式摆在一起对比。
why_en: It contrasts neon() HTTP mode against Pool WebSocket mode, telling you which query belongs on which path instead of just handing.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 JavaScript/TypeScript 侧的 @neondatabase/serverless 用法。
limit_en: Only covers @neondatabase/serverless for JS/TS, no other language drivers. HTTP mode has no session state or interactive transactions; use WebSocket.
title_en: Reach PlanetScale Postgres from edge runtimes via the Neon.
